title: CONTROLS LIST FOLDS AWAY AFTER 30 SECONDS
why: UI step 4, the HUD in play. The style guide says the controls list is hidden except on F1 and in the first 30 seconds. It sat over the play space for a whole raid on the first three. It still opens on arrival (his v6.68 note) and now folds to the one-line hint 30 seconds in. F1 cycles it as before.
now: The controls list folds to its one-line hint 30 seconds into a raid. F1 opens it again.
